value.message: Year-end: QLH would harvest {count} lot(s) ({loss} of losses). Ask the client about gains realized elsewhere this year so their tax adviser can use these losses; losses beyond gains offset up to $3,000 of ordinary income and carry forward.

value.message: Year-end: {loss} of losses sit below the {threshold} QLH threshold, so QLH will not harvest them. Realizing them before December 31 would be a separate, advisor-directed sale; mind the 30-day wash sale window.

sections.title: Year-end tax check
sections.body:
- {harvest} of harvestable losses in the account (~{tax_alpha} illustrative tax value).
- Ask the client about gains realized elsewhere this year (other accounts, property, a business sale) so their tax adviser can use these losses.
- No sale within 30 days of buying the same security (wash sale).
